name: login-role-safe-return-route
title: Redirect re-login to a route allowed for the new account
description: Prevent a newly authenticated account from inheriting an inaccessible protected route recorded by the previous logged-out account.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The backend login payload already returns the new account role. The fix belongs at the frontend return-route boundary and reuses canAccessRoute/getRoleHomeRoute.
